hytaleFaq.text6b6tHytaleServerIsAPureAnarchyServer: 6b6t Hytale server is a pure anarchy server. Griefing, raiding, and PvP are all permitted. As the first anarchy server in Hytale, we offer absolute freedom with no bans.
hytaleFaq.whatMakesThisTheFirstAnarchyServer: What makes this the first anarchy server?
hytaleFaq.text6b6tWentLiveJustMinutesAfterHytaleSG: 6b6t went live just minutes after Hytale's global launch on January 13, 2026. We established the first true anarchy environment in Hytale history, creating a permanent world that will never be reset.
hytaleFaq.theMapOf6b6tHytaleServerWillNeverReset: The map of 6b6t Hytale server will never reset. 6b6t is the oldest anarchy server in Hytale, started on January 13, 2026. This world is permanent, preserving your builds and history forever.
hytaleFaq.absolutelyNot6b6tIsAFreeAnarchyServerFoc: Absolutely not. 6b6t is a free anarchy server focused on fair play. Ensuring no Pay-2-Win advantages.

hytaleFeaturedVideo.watchTheLatestVideoAbout6b6tFromFitmcThe: Watch the latest video about 6b6t from FitMC. The largest and the oldest anarchy server in Hytale.
